newsitem.title: UK: Granada rues missed soccer chances.
newsitem.headline: Granada rues missed soccer chances.

text.p: Granada chairman Gerry Robinson said on Wednesday it was "too late" for the company to invest in soccer club stocks and rued the fact they had not done so five years ago.
"I think it's too late," Robinson told reporters when asked whether media and leisure company Granada planned to buy into any of Britain's top soccer clubs.
Granada was last year rumoured as a potential bidder for English soccer champions Manchester United.
Robinson said that his Granada colleague Steve Morrison had urged the company to invest in Manchester United in the early 1990s but his pleas had fallen on deaf eras.
"If you'd bought half a dozen clubs five years ago you'd be a very happy man now," said Robinson.
